# A basic 2D map of the world, the land of Natural Earth on the sea, which MapComponent provides as a widget (see
# README.md). Its components are in src/; its class, CartographiePlugin.h, in which they register, is generated by
# nebula_add_plugin in the build directory.
set(CMAKE_AUTORCC ON)
nebula_add_plugin(
    NAME CartographiePlugin
    DESCRIPTION "A basic 2D map of the world, provided as a widget"
    # The land of the map, compiled into the plugin through basemap.qrc: it is not shipped apart.
    SOURCES ../data/basemap.qrc
    # Its map is a widget.
    LINK_LIBRARIES PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets
)
